reuse.why: Introduces getMonthActionCategories, getFixedCostGroupIds and forEachMonthActionCategory and routes setZero, the averages and the new setLastMonthSpending through them, reusing setNMonthAvg, setBudget and getSheetValue; copyPreviousMonth reuses only the fixed-group lookup.

duplication.why: copyPreviousMonth keeps a row-level copy of the hidden/hidden-group, #fixed and saved-template exclusions (with its own includeHiddenCategories branch) parallel to the helper's SQL, and setZero keeps its own income-in-tracking loop beside forEachMonthActionCategory.

placement.why: The selection rules live in budget/actions.ts as shared helpers next to the actions and the new method is registered with its siblings in budget/app.ts; only copyPreviousMonth applies the rules at its own site.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (exclusions, new action, #fixed groups, opt-in hidden flag) plus tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Most actions share one selection and loop, but the category rules must still be kept in sync in two shapes (SQL helper and copyPreviousMonth's row checks), and setZero is a half-migrated sibling of forEachMonthActionCategory.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts decides hidden, #fixed and goal_def exclusions inline instead of using getMonthActionCategories; setZero iterates and applies the income rule itself instead of using forEachMonthActionCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The parallel exclusion chain in copyPreviousMonth is an openly separate copy in row form, not a renamed or reshaped one.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains the includeHiddenCategories parameter (threaded through forEachMonthActionCategory); copyPreviousMonth re-implements the helper's exclusions at the row level instead of calling it.
